content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation states that, where a supplier is participating in a procurement procedure and has been involved in the preparation of that procurement (in the context of regulation 40 PCR 2015 or otherwise), the contracting authority must take appropriate measures to ensure that competition is not distorted by the participation of the supplier. Regulation 41 also applies where a supplier participating in a procurement is connected to another supplier which has been involved in the preparation of the procurement procedure.
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Overview

content_blocks.text: Appropriate measures must include:
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Overview

content_blocks.text: informing all other suppliers of any relevant information exchanged with the supplier(s) involved in the preparation of the procurement procedure, and
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Overview

content_blocks.text: allowing adequate time for the receipt of tenders, i.e. by allowing the other suppliers enough time to review the information (insofar as the information might impact on tenders).
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Overview

content_blocks.text: Contracting authorities should exclude suppliers on the basis of their prior involvement, only where there are no means available to ensure that all suppliers are treated equally (complying with the duty in regulation 18(1); principles of procurement). Any exclusion on this basis should only take place once the supplier concerned has been given an opportunity to prove that its prior involvement is not capable of distorting competition.
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Overview

content_blocks.text: Objective at this commercial stage
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Appropriate measures should be put in place to ensure that the participating supplier’s prior involvement in the preparation of the procurement will not have the effect of distorting competition.
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Key considerations at this commercial stage
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Contracting authorities should:
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: ensure that effective measures are taken to prevent or remedy, as appropriate, any identified potential or actual distortion of competition
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: ensure that, where appropriate, information known to individual suppliers is shared with the wider market to prevent any distortion of competition; including giving sufficient time to the wider market to review the information (insofar as the information might impact on tenders)
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: ensure that a robust audit trail is maintained with respect to any decisions made in relation to preventing, identifying and remedying any potential or actual distortion of competition.
heading_path: Prior involvement of candidates or tenderers
